svg.text: Vertex uses live GPS to walk you across campus and pick the
best door. Then it keeps going where GPS can't: up the right
stairs, down the right hallway, to the room on your schedule.
Walks you to the best door for your room.
Research Hall, Merten, the JC and The HUB.
No app store. No account. No download.
An independent student project. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by George Mason University.
